title: First-divergence view -- a compact projection of clozn.analysis.model_diff.diff_runs onto where two recorded token streams first stopped being identical
description: Nested at `first_divergence_view` on every successful clozn.analysis.model_diff.diff_runs() result (POST /diff/runs). Never a second diff algorithm: `divergence`/`common_prefix` are read from that SAME comparison's own `first_divergence`/`common_prefix_len` (computed on the full recorded traces, never the 200-position display cap), so the two can never structurally disagree. This is an exact, OBSERVATIONAL split between two independently-generated runs -- 'controlled' means only that the user-side prompt sequence matched under the diff's own contract; it never explains why a model/config change produced the divergent token. state=trace_unavailable: one or both runs carry no usable per-token trace, so no token-level claim (not even 'identical') can be made. state=identical: the recorded token streams matched all the way through -- never inferred from character/formatting equality after token equality already settled it. state=available: a real divergence exists in trace space, with symmetric 'almost said' evidence in both directions and exact recorded-answer-string offsets only when each side's own recorded trace pieces reconstruct that side's own recorded response character for character.

trace_missing.description: Present only when state=trace_unavailable -- which run(s) ('a'/'b') carry no usable per-token trace.

controlled.description: Exactly prompts_match -- 'the user-side prompt sequence matched under this diff's own contract', never a causal claim about what produced the divergent token.

last_shared_index.description: token_count - 1, or null when the streams diverged at token zero (nothing shared yet).

piece.description: The recorded token piece text. null only for the exhausted side of a length_mismatch divergence.

token_id.description: The recorded token id when this run's trace captured one -- never retokenized to recover a missing id.

found.description: null (UNKNOWN) when checked=false -- never collapsed into false. The target run recorded no alternatives at all at this position, which is a different honest state from 'checked and not found'.

rank.description: 0-based rank within the target's RECORDED alternatives list only -- not a full-vocabulary rank.

a_considered_b.description: Was b's committed divergent token present in a's recorded alternatives?

b_considered_a.description: Was a's committed divergent token present in b's recorded alternatives? (the symmetric reverse lookup)

basis.description: Sliced from the full recorded per-token trace arrays -- never a re-tokenization of response text, and never the capped `positions` list.
